description: This file defines the RouteCollectorInterface interface within the Slim Framework, specifying methods related to route management such as retrieving route parsers, setting cache files, managing routes and route names, and grouping routes. It declares the API for route collection operations in the framework.

classes.name: RouteCollectorInterface
classes.description: Interface defining methods for collecting, managing, and retrieving route information within the Slim Framework, including route parsing, caching, grouping, and retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: getDefaultInvocationStrategy
methods.description: Retrieve the default route invocation strategy.

methods.name: setDefaultInvocationStrategy
methods.description: Set the default route invocation strategy.

methods.name: getCacheFile
methods.description: Get the file path to FastRoute cache.

methods.name: setCacheFile
methods.description: Set the file path to FastRoute cache, with exception handling.

methods.name: getBasePath
methods.description: Retrieve the base path used in route URL generation.

methods.name: setBasePath
methods.description: Set the base path used for route URL generation.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Get all route objects as an array.

methods.name: getNamedRoute
methods.description: Retrieve a route object by its name, throws if not found.

methods.name: removeNamedRoute
methods.description: Remove a route by its name, throws if not found.

methods.name: lookupRoute
methods.description: Lookup a route by its unique identifier, throws if not found.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Add a route group with pattern and callable or class string.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Add a route for specific HTTP methods, pattern, and handler.
